parameters.content:
## ⏰ Relances automatiques
Chaque matin de semaine à 9h :
- repère les candidatures **sans nouvelles depuis 7 jours**
- l'IA rédige un **email de relance** poli et personnalisé
- tu le reçois sur Telegram avec des boutons (relancé, entretien, refus, plus tard)
- après 2 relances sans réponse, la candidature passe en **👻 sans réponse**

parameters.query:
UPDATE jobs j SET status = 'ghosted'
FROM applications a
WHERE a.job_id = j.id
  AND j.status = 'applied'
  AND a.followup_count >= 2
  AND COALESCE(a.last_followup_at, a.applied_at) < now() - interval '10 days'
RETURNING j.id, j.title, j.company;

SELECT a.id AS application_id, a.applied_at, a.followup_count,
       j.id AS job_id, j.title, j.company, j.url, j.summary,
       (SELECT content FROM documents d
         WHERE d.job_id = j.id AND d.kind = 'cover_letter'
         ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cover_letter,
       p.full_name
FROM applications a
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id
CROSS JOIN profile p
WHERE j.status = 'applied'
  AND a.next_followup_at <= now()
  AND a.followup_count < 2
ORDER BY a.next_followup_at
LIMIT 10;
